BETA Close X Serco Group plc has purchased a total of 1,578,550 ordinary shares between August 24th and August 28th, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The average price paid per share across these transactions was approximately 260.44 pence. Following these purchases, Serco Group plc now has 970,434,545 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and a total of 32,311,469 ordinary shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights, excluding treasury shares, stands at 970,434,545 as of August 28th, 2026.
